name: @sentinel/watch
description: Self-hosted release monitoring for public npm MCP servers, built on the Sentinel analyzer.

scripts.//deploy: Deploys from wrangler.private.toml, which is gitignored and holds the real D1 database_id. The committed wrangler.toml keeps a placeholder so this public repository never identifies a Cloudflare account.
scripts.deploy:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('wrangler.private.toml')){console.log('wrangler.private.toml already exists.');process.exit(0)}fs.copyFileSync('wrangler.toml','wrangler.private.toml');console.log('Created wrangler.private.toml. Put your real database_id in it; it is gitignored.')"
